name: hud
description: Two coloured, animated lines under the prompt, every figure named: model, effort, context window, rate limits, turn timer, tool calls, agents, git state, worktree, cost, session length and folder.

theme.title: Colour theme

placement.title: Where the row is drawn
placement.description: Below the prompt, above Claude Code's hint line, or in the band above the prompt.
